answer: SELECT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000

WITH cyr AS (SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption, AVG(y.Consumption) AS avg_consumption FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment), ranked AS (SELECT Segment, avg_consumption, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) AS rn FROM cyr), mins AS (SELECT Segment, avg_consumption FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT (SELECT avg_consumption FROM mins WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM mins WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM, (SELECT avg_consumption FROM mins WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM mins WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM, (SELECT avg_consumption FROM mins WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM mins WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME' AND Currency = 'CZK') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME' AND Currency = 'EUR') AS diff

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN c.CustomerID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
SELECT g.Country FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) = '2013-06'
